story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date as transaction effective date for new enrollment before eligibility begins

flagged.why: edge case lacks a negative outcome

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS001_003 is "Edge", but Test Step Expected Result text contains no error, rejection, or absent record outcome; for example Step 7 Expected Result: "The transmission shows completed processing with accepted validation and successful policy unit delivery for the boundary-condition file."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date as transaction effective date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: negative case assumes a rejection rule

gaps: Description field contains "Verify the system does not load the changed-assessment-date transaction effective date logic when an AR PASSE inbound 834 update for current eligibility is submitted without a valid changed Assessment Date." which is not supported by the scenario acceptance criteria "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and the Assessment Date has changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date."

Test Step Expected Result field contains "The transmission shows a failed, errored, rejected, or otherwise non-success status for the member update because no valid changed Assessment Date was supplied for the current eligibility scenario." which asserts a rejection outcome not stated in the scenario acceptance criteria

scenarios.title: Use changed Assessment Date and preserve relevant field values when only Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the negative case expects the wrong outcome

gaps: Id 'TC_TS003_002' with Status field 'Negative' is not aligned to scenario type '"type": "Positive"' from the source scenario; this batch was built from a Positive scenario only.

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS004_003 is "Edge"

For id TC_TS004_003, no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record; examples include "The edge-condition file is created successfully and represents a no-change future-span transaction.", "The file is present in the inbound location and ready for pickup.", "The file is listed in TM search results.", "The baseline counts for existing eligibility and processed eligibility rows are returned for the member."

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged

flagged.why: the edge case has no rejection outcome

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS005_003 is "Edge", but Test Step Expected Result text only says "The member rows are returned, but the boundary-condition transaction does not show DTP*303 being used as the transaction effective date because the member was not in an already-started current eligibility state when the file was processed." and contains no error, rejection, or absent record result.

scenarios.title: Regression verification that Maintenance Date is not overused and downstream financial impact is unchanged

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an error path

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS007_003 is "Edge" but its Test Step Expected Result text only states absent records, e.g. "No new SBEL row is returned with a newly populated effective date caused by this boundary-condition file." and never describes an error or rejection.

scenarios.title: Use first date occurrence when multiple candidate dates are present in inbound 834
